# Version 4.151.0
> **Faster drawing and text shaping** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 restores CPU bitmap-rendering performance and reduces shaping and color-conversion overhead.

## Breaking Changes

- **Remove whitespace after the color prefix** — SKColor.Parse and TryParse now reject whitespace immediately after # in six- and eight-digit forms. Remove that whitespace before parsing; ordinary outer whitespace and case-insensitive hexadecimal input remain supported. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))

## Engine

- **Skia m151** — Updates the bundled renderer to m151 without changing the managed API or native C API. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294))

## API Surface

- **Span-based color and tag parsing** — Adds ReadOnlySpan<char> parsing for SKColor, SKFourByteTag, and HarfBuzzSharp.Tag so callers can parse slices without allocating substrings. Color and tag parsing also do less work per call. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396), [#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Lower color-conversion overhead** — SKColor-to-SKColorF conversion and single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply use managed math with native-equivalent results, avoiding per-color interop calls. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385))
- **Fewer shaping allocations** — UTF-8 string insertion reuses an encoding buffer, and SKShaper reads glyph results through spans instead of copying two native arrays. Shaping output is unchanged. ([#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376), [#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388))
- **Deterministic subset cleanup** — SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) disposes the intermediate full image when Subset returns a different instance, while preserving same-instance returns. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))

## Bug Fixes

- **CPU image rendering performance restored** — Restores the previous optimized CPU shader path for scaled and tiled bitmap drawing, addressing high CPU use, dropped frames, and flicker in affected applications. ([#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428))
- **GPU text destruction order** — Corrects a native use-after-free when corrupt serialized GPU text data is rejected. ([#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382))
- **Ganesh stencil and resolve tracking** — Corrects stencil-clear coordinates, ensures stencil is cleared when preservation requires it, and restores dirty tracking when a resolve task does not execute. ([#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489))

## Platform

- **.NET 11 WebAssembly assets** — Adds Emscripten 5.0.6 native archives for .NET 11 and compiles them with its new exception-handling model. .NET 8 and .NET 9/10 retain their existing toolchain mappings. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Reduces UTF-8 insertion allocations and adds span-based Tag.Parse. Matching Emscripten 5.0.6 archives are provided for .NET 11; the native HarfBuzz version remains 14.2.1.

## Release Candidate 1 (July 21, 2026)

Restored CPU bitmap-rendering performance, moved single-color conversions to managed math, and fixed intermediate subset-image cleanup. Added matching .NET 11 WebAssembly archives and exception handling, plus Ganesh stencil and resolve corrections.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.151.0-preview.2.1...v4.151.0-rc.1.1)

## Preview 2 (July 14, 2026)

Added span-based color and tag parsing and reduced shaping allocations. Color parsing now rejects whitespace immediately after #, and native GPU text teardown is corrected.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.151.0-preview.1.1...v4.151.0-preview.2.1)
